content:
transcription from #books

about a year ago i got a used kindle to read manga. i saw a video that explained how to jailbreak it, where it explained that with koreader you could read manga if i transformed them to pdf using mokuro (takes manga and makes ocr'd pdfs with selectable text).

however i also took the oportunity to read actual books. i've never been one to do so. prior to this the last book i'd read would probably be the last book they made me read in highschool.

transcribed list of books ive started and/or finished:

before kindle era:
art & fear start 5/6/22 15:17 end 3/11/22 17:04 en el subte
atomic habits start: 5/6/22 end: 6/9/22 13:00 mientras el flaco de io llegaba tarde
Spinetta ruido de magia Start 8/1/23 (unfinished)
graphic design the new basics terminado 24/7/24. lo arranque ayer lol
dune 10/2 (unfinished)
ted chiang story of your life 16/10/25

after kindle era:
Black holes Brian Cox 10-16/11/25
ted chiang story of your life and others finished 15/5 23.40 arriba del 42
a mathematician's apology 5/6 23:16 volviendo de tipo en el 42
annihilation 30/8 0:03 sabado a la noche en la q me quedé en casa
self compassion 6/9 a la noche en mi cama preparandome para el lunes
the man who loved only numbers 21/9 23:25 prendiendo el auto
easy peasy 29/9 15:33 almorzando para nunca mas
snow crash 19/10 14:12 almorzando con tercer rayo de sol q se digno a darme esta primavera. muy cortado el ending. me recontra sorprendio cuando salto el cartel de libro terminado del kindle. me vine a la compu a buscar un pdf para ver si no me faltaba algo. what do you mean??
estrella distante 7/11 en carilo 14:26 con los restos de la chimenea incendiada
